name: Exage ES 3×7 combined shift/brake pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 395 g for the complete ST-M520 left/right 3×7 combined shift/brake control set with 2.5-finger levers. The matching front/rear tables establish both controls; no single-side mass is doubled.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1993 dealer product manual, PDF page 31 / printed 31: Exage ES exact inventory: RD-M520-SGS 301 g, GS/SGS limits including 20T front difference, ST-M520 complete 3x7 controls 395 g, FC-M520 170 mm 46/36/26T 706 g, CS-HG70-7 E 12–28T 309 g
